D: Santa's daughter heads to Phoenix to find her brother, who has run off before Christmas.
P: Serve the snacks when Noelle lands in Phoenix.
S: Chipotle chicken, charred corn, feta and lime crema in corn tortillas

Chipotle chicken thigh tacos with charred corn, cotija-style feta, pickled red onion, lime crema and coriander in warm corn tortillas. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with a pinch of salt and sugar. Toss 600g chicken thigh with 1 tbsp chipotle sauce, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tbsp oil and grill 5 minutes a side, then slice. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Mix 150g sour cream with lime juice. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with chicken, corn, crumbled feta, crema, onion and coriander.
Dark and white chocolate bark with crushed peppermint candy canes

Layers of dark and white chocolate swirled together with peppermint, crushed candy canes and a pinch of sea salt, snapped into shards. Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 200g dark chocolate and spread into a 25 x 30cm rectangle. Chill 10 minutes. Melt 200g white chocolate with 1/4 tsp peppermint extract and spread over the dark layer, then drag a skewer through to swirl. Scatter with 5 crushed candy canes and a pinch of sea salt flakes. Chill 30 minutes until set and snap into shards.
M: Maple Dijon roast chicken with potatoes, honey carrots and gravy

Golden roast chicken glazed with maple, mustard and thyme, with crispy potatoes, honey roasted carrots and a rich pan gravy. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, salt and thyme leaves. Roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes, brushing with 3 tbsp maple syrup mixed with 1 tbsp Dijon for the last 20 minutes. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and roast alongside for 50 minutes, adding 4 carrots tossed in 1 tbsp honey for the last 35. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices with 350ml chicken stock for gravy.
W: Buttery cut-out sugar cookies with icing

Vanilla butter sugar cookies cut into stars, trees and reindeer, iced in red, green and white with a little edible glitter. Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 1 tsp vanilla, then mix in 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut out stars, trees and reindeer and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool. Mix 250g icing sugar with 2 to 3 tbsp water, divide into 3 bowls and tint red and green, leaving one white. Ice the cookies and dust with edible glitter.
K: Raspberry lemon slush topped with lemonade

A bright icy slushie of frozen raspberries, lemon and blue cordial blended with lemonade, topped with a puff of whipped cream for desert Christmas. Blend 150g frozen raspberries, the juice of 2 lemons, 80ml blue raspberry cordial and 3 cups ice until slushy. Add 600ml cold lemonade and pulse twice to mix. Pour into 4 cups. Top each with a little whipped cream from 100ml thickened cream and a few freeze-dried or fresh raspberries. Serve with spoons and straws.

veg.n: Phoenix street corn chipotle mushroom tacos
veg.make_ahead: Pickle the onion up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill the mushrooms and warm the tortillas on the night

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt and sugar.
Toss the mushrooms with the chipotle sauce, cumin and oil and grill on both sides until tender and charred.
Char the corn and cut off the kernels.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice. Warm the tortillas.
Fill with mushrooms, corn, feta, crema, onion and coriander.

dishes.make_ahead: Make up to 1 week ahead; chill until set, then snap into shards and keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Line a tray with baking paper. Melt the dark chocolate and spread into a rectangle.
Chill the dark layer.
Melt the white chocolate with the peppermint extract, spread over the dark layer and drag a skewer through to swirl.
Scatter with crushed candy cane and sea salt.
Chill until set, then snap into shards.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the chicken with butter, salt and thyme up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the day and make the gravy from the pan juices

steps.text: Rub the chicken with the butter, salt and thyme leaves.
Roast at 200C, brushing with the maple syrup mixed with Dijon for the last part.
Toss the potatoes in oil and roast alongside, adding the carrots tossed in honey part way through.
Rest the chicken.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices with the stock for gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Boil and butter the cauliflowers up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast with the potatoes on the day

steps.text: Boil the cauliflowers whole for 6 minutes, drain, then rub with the butter, salt and thyme leaves.
Toss the potatoes in oil and put them in the oven at 200C with the cauliflowers. Toss the carrots in the honey ready to add.
Roast for 45 minutes, adding the carrots part way through and brushing the cauliflowers with the maple syrup mixed with Dijon for the last 15 minutes.
Rest the cauliflowers.
Cook the flour in a little oil from the potato tray, then whisk in the stock and soy for gravy.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Beat the butter with some of the icing sugar, add the egg yolk and vanilla, then mix in the flour.
Chill the dough.
Roll out and cut stars, trees and reindeer.
Bake at 170C, then cool.
Mix the remaining icing sugar with water, divide into three bowls and tint red and green, leaving one white. Ice the cookies and dust with edible glitter.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended just before serving; whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead and keep it chilled

steps.text: Blend the frozen raspberries, lemon juice, cordial and ice until slushy.
Add the lemonade and pulse twice to mix.
Pour into cups, top with whipped cream and a few raspberries.
Serve with spoons and straws.
